title: Document _global key in Sieve implementation
description: The magic string '_global' is used as the single Sieve script key throughout the codebase, but lacks documentation explaining: (1) what _global means and why it exists, (2) where to look to understand the single-user delivery model. A future maintainer needs a high-level doc comment explaining the architectural choice. Consider adding a module-level doc comment to session.rs or sieve_admin.rs explaining that this is a single-user system with a global Sieve script evaluated for all mail.
